content.scenario: After mediation, the mediator prepares a settlement report and obtains the signed agreement from both parties. The mediator then forwards the report and agreement to the concerned Commission.
content.outcome: The mediator prepares a settlement report of the settlement and forwards the signed agreement along with the report to the concerned Commission, as required by the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
